description.narrative: The Fiscal Transparency and Accountability Initiative (FTAI) carried out by Transparency International Australia is a regional program to strengthen accountability and transparency in public investment management (PIM) and infrastructure decision-making. The program will raise awareness among citizens of the impact of poor investment decisions and devise strategies for Transparency International (TI) Chapters, civil society, and other stakeholders to hold governments accountable for infrastructure investment decisions and improve national and international policy frameworks. It develops TI national chaptersâ€™ capacity and technical knowledge of infrastructure project selection and the PIM process, supports national civil society awareness-raising campaigns, and advocates at the national level for increased accountability of infrastructure investment decisions.
